sources.title: What is Fine-Tuning? | IBM
sources.snippet: Fine-tuning in machine learning is the process of adapting a pre-trained model for specific tasks or use cases. It has become a fundamental deep learning technique, particularly in the training process of foundation models used for generative AI.
